column1: # The Play 6 recipe (dragon_healthy: XGIMI Play 6 G0058, mt5889, 32-bit userspace, Android 11 vendor with VNDK 30):
# steps of tools/build/engine.py, WHEN<TAB>OP<TAB>ARGS, run as root inside the lineage-builder container (/src the
# LineageOS source, /out the base build, /work the staged inputs and outputs). Why each step: tools/play6/compose.sh
# history and docs/play6. Every APK and APEX staged carries the Play 6 keys (rule S1, check_signers.py on the Mac).
# Flags: test (tN), diag, usbadb, nodex (--no-dexpreopt), expall/exp (--exp, --exp=N,...), gms (the Google test
# edition, never a release), ota (the updater and the recovery certificate).
# the keystone SurfaceFlinger of step 1d and the base it was built over (build.conf SF_SHA, SF_BASE_SHA)
# the base is the very one the Mac signed (base_export.sh id: every entry of the system tree)
# 0. APEX modules uncompressed (apexd would unpack every .capex before the vendor's early-boot drivers)
# 0a. rule S1: the base's platform set, the APEXes with such APKs and mac_permissions, re-signed on the Mac; the folders
#     of the replaced files get a new mtime (PackageManager's parse cache goes by it)
# 0b. no second setup flow (LineageOS SetupWizard and TvProvision), then the debloat (shared lists + the Play 6 line)
# 0c. key layouts and the remote's idc in /product/usr (read before /vendor; XGIMI's do not parse on Android 14)
# 1a. vendor compatibility (bind mounts at boot), the lens-mode mount point, always-on settings
# 1c. the vendor's projector driver chain (kheaders ... mik, stock init.fusion.rc order) at late-fs in EVERY image:
#     MBOOT's 60 s hardware watchdog is taken over only by gmpf_main, within its 30 tries, and only once mik.ko is in
#    ; left to the vendor's early-boot, a first boot on clean data comes too late
# 1d. keystone like stock: the stock SurfaceFlinger warps the whole UI on the GPU with GL_LINEAR on every layer into a
#     4x MSAA target (GLESTrapezoidalRenderEngine), lineage/patches/play6/0002 does the same since lumen-os d0ba63d.
#     The base build in /out is older, its own binary warps with nearest sampling, so every frame of an auto keystone
#     run crawls. The binary built over this very base replaces it. fs_config
#     and file_contexts of build_image give it root:shell 0755 and surfaceflinger_exec as before
# 1, 1b. the framework config RRO and the TvSettings switch fix
# 2. the projector app and its remote-pairing permissions
# 3. Lumen Home, TvInput, the LineageOS platform values, sysconfig, Lumen Setup, the 1.0.8 bridges
# 3d. screen mirroring and AirPlay, the receivers of the Z9X. The Miracast sink is a priv-app (two privileged
#     permissions), its runtime permissions granted by default, and the Wi-Fi Direct device type is television for
#     Windows (static RRO); it shows its quick menu tile only where it found Wi-Fi Direct. AirPlay loads its
#     armeabi-v7a library straight from the APK, so the library must be stored and page-aligned there.
# 3e. --ota: the updater (/cache, XGIMI's recovery installs it), the recovery certificate, lumen_recovery
# 3f. the Google add-on partition (lumen_gapps in super): overlay mounts when it exists
# 3h. no Wi-Fi or Bluetooth driver of our own: V1.8.127 drives both chips (MediaTek MT7663 and AIC8800) itself, and the
#     installer refuses an AIC unit on V1.7.116 (tools/play6/test_play6_no_aic.sh keeps the image free of AIC files)
# 3g. the vendor native-UI fifo reader (eye protection), the Z9X files unchanged
# 4. Lumen boot animation (the -dark link keeps pointing at it)
# 5. the USB-stick boot logger and its device hooks (test builds with --diag)
# 5a. --gms: the Google test edition (inputs never in the repository); Lumen Home stays HOME
# 5b. Lumen Setup is HOME on wiped data
# 6. build-time AOT (speed) of Lumen Home, the projector app, Lumen Setup and the screen mirroring and AirPlay receivers
#    against this base's boot image (the receivers run from boot on a low-memory unit: no JIT warm-up)
